{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer in navy blue with a tailored fit and notched lapels, crafted from a fine worsted wool blend, Hex #1B2956.
High-waisted trousers in matching midnight charcoal, featuring a clean crease and slim ankle silhouette, woven from stretch tropical wool, Hex #36454F.
A crisp silk-blend blouse in ivory with a subtle sheen and a button-front placket, cut with a relaxed but polished drape, Hex #FFFFF0.
Loafers in polished black leather with a low stacked heel and a sleek silhouette, finished with minimal branding, Hex #1C1C1C.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an early morning banking interview by projecting professionalism and competence while remaining comfortable enough for all-day wear. The dark navy and charcoal tones convey authority and seriousness appropriate for the finance sector, while the ivory blouse adds a necessary touch of approachability. The choice of wool fabrics ensures warmth against the autumn chill without appearing overly bulky or restrictive during movement."}
